caption_L1: Here a is a bar graph titled Number of military fatalities in all major wars involving the United States from 1775 to 2021. A categorical scale from American Civil War (1861-1865) to World War II (1939-1945) can be found along the x-axis, labeled War (and years of U\.S\. military involvement). There is a linear scale from 0 to 600,000 along the y-axis, labeled Number of fatalities.
caption_L2L3: The highest fatalies to date were in the american civil war and the lowest in the american spanish war. The most recent war brought the second highest fatalities.
